caption: John Abbot. “Papilio Ajax. Annona Palustris.” From The Natural History of the Rarer Lepidopterous Insects of Georgia. Printed by T. Bensley, for J. Edwards [etc.]. 1797. Tab 4.
alt: A hand-coloured engraving of a pawpaw branch with broad green leaves and a single small green fruit, a pale green caterpillar resting on the stem, and two black-and-white striped zebra swallowtail butterflies with red and blue markings, one above the branch and one below.
title: Papilio Ajax. Annona Palustris

edition.title: The Natural History of the Rarer Lepidopterous Insects of Georgia
